Emily: Quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem — running a short sync on action items for the missing spans / aggregation mismatch / ETL lag. I pulled the checklist into the doc. Can we confirm owners and deadlines?
Sarah: I'll own the ETL backfills + schema validation investigation. ETA end of week, will start looking at failing DAG runs now.
Raj: I'll pick up the missing spans instrumentation fix — looks like the tracer rejects malformed timestamps. Plan is sanitizer in SDK + tests. Target: Tue next week.
Mike: I'll add a temporary alert for aggregate gaps and wire up a dashboard panel so we can track regressions.
Jen: Flagging customer comms — do we need an external note or just support-facing guidance?
Sarah: quick find from job logs: backfill failing on 2026-03-20 due to schema drift. Sample error: ```ValueError: cannot parse timestamp '2026-03-20T25:00:00'``` — I'll add strict schema checks and a remediation backfill plan.
Raj: that timestamp explains missing spans (they were dropped in ingestion). I'll add a tolerant parser behind a feature flag and include strict parsing as a test.
Emily: Drafting consolidated action list for the postmortem closure: 1) Sarah — fix backfills, add schema validation, and run bounded recompute for last 7 days (due 2026-03-27). 2) Raj — SDK sanitizer + unit tests + canary rollout (due 2026-03-24). 3) Mike — alert + temporary dashboard + SLO noise tuning (due 2026-03-23). 4) Jen — draft customer comms and support FAQ (due 2026-03-25). 5) Emily — update postmortem with remediation notes and closure criteria (due 2026-03-28). Please confirm or suggest adjustments.
Sarah: confirmed. I'll post run IDs and progress here. Backfill plan: windowed recompute in 24h chunks to avoid OOM.
Raj: confirmed. I'll open a PR today with tests and a compatibility flag. Canary rollout plan: 10% of hosts -> 50% -> 100% if metrics stable.
Mike: added alert rule: `rate(agg_missing_spans_total[5m]) / rate(expected_spans_total[5m]) > 0.01` and a dashboard at /dashboards/observability/agg-health. Will also add a runbook.
Jen: drafting the comms now — leaning towards customer advisory + internal support blurb. Will share draft by EOD Friday.
oncall-bot: Follow-up ticket created: INC-2026-042. Owners assigned: [Sarah, Raj, Mike, Jen, Emily]. Next check-in scheduled: 2026-03-25 15:00 UTC.
Emily: Thanks everyone. Please post updates here as you make progress so I can mark items as resolved in the postmortem. If we see the same failure pattern again, we'll schedule a deeper recurring review to look for systemic ETL brittleness. :thumbsup:
